pageTitle: Is the court hearing in the next 14 days?
caption: Make an application
heading: Is the court hearing in the next 14 days?
question: Is the court hearing in the next 14 days?
hintText: This will affect the fee you will pay. You do not need to pay a fee if your court hearing is (at least) 14 days away.
otherParties: The ‘other parties’ are the other people or organisations named on the claim form. For example a tenant, landlord, housing association, or mortgage lender.
everyOtherPartyWillNeedToAgree: Every other party will need to agree to let you make this application, if they don’t agree, you may need to pay a higher fee.

errors.inNext14Days: Confirm whether the court hearing is in the next 14 days

genAppCuiSetAside.hintText: This will affect the fee you will pay. You do not need to pay a fee if your court hearing is (at least) 14 days away and all the other parties have agreed to it.
